goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged.
summary: The playtester claimed a plot (auto-claim), bought three upgrades and waited while the counters ran. cubes_dropped (172), cubes_collected (163), cashin_fx_sent (161) and Cash all rose, map_built=1 and plaza_built=1 were correct, and the probe showed no errors. The themes_built=6 assertion failed (the counter read 12), checks_failed was non-zero, and the session never showed the pre-claim cubes_dropped=0 check or the hand-off of the failing check to the fixer. The goal was not fully met.
